newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu, local firm win Philippine telecom deal.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu, local firm win Philippine telecom deal.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd said on Tuesday that it and a local firm had won a $60 million telecom contract in the Philippines from Telecom Infrastructure Corp of the Philippines.
Fujitsu and its Philippine unit, Fujitsu Philippines Inc, together with Alcatel Philippines Inc, were awarded the contract for a national digital transmission network, Fujitsu said in a statement.
The contracts were signed on Tuesday in Manila and the project is due to be comleted by the end of December.

Fujitsu said it would supply a synchoronous digital hierarchy (SDH) network system comprising three parts: a microwave system, a land cable system and a submarine cable system. The network would be supplied with the collaboration of Tonen Corp and installed by Fujitsu Philippines and Alcatel Philippines.
Telecom Infrastructure Corp of the Philippines, a joint venture company of eight telecom carriers, is constructing an independent telecom network infrastructure, it said.
